home.motto: Open to part-time B2B work · around 20 h/week · Prague hybrid or fully remote
home.valueProp: Products taken from an empty repository to production. A zero-trust data provenance platform, an EV charging network with live payments, and a course scheduler I still run today.
home.nowDesc: A course scheduler for VŠE students that I created and maintain alone. It scrapes InSIS, offers better search and scheduling than the university system, and runs with monitoring, alerting and automatic deployments.
home.workP: Every project below I shipped end to end: infrastructure, backend, and UI.
home.servicesP: Part-time B2B engagements. I take full responsibility for the area I own: architecture, code, delivery, deployment.
home.service1Title: Ship a new product from scratch
home.service1Desc: Idea to production. I own the stack, ship the MVP, and deploy it. I took an EV charging platform from an empty repository to public launch in five months.
home.service2Desc: Diagnose, stabilize, and set up the pipelines so your team can move again.
home.service3Title: Grow the platform alongside the team
home.service3Desc: Ongoing fractional senior engineer: code review, architecture, and mentoring. The way I worked with CORAC Engineering and Intedat.
home.testimonialsH2: Real feedback from real teammates and managers.
home.testimonialsP: Pulled directly from LinkedIn recommendations, unedited.
home.projectKreditozroutiDesc: A course scheduler for VŠE students, live at kreditozrouti.cz and used by 300+ students. I created it and run it alone: InSIS scraping, better search and scheduling than the university offers, with monitoring, alerting and automatic deployments. It led to my bachelor thesis.
home.projectCoraSithDesc: Client-side hash-chain verification, D3.js supply-chain graphs, and zero-trust auth for a sensitive EO data pipeline. Sole frontend engineer.
home.projectIontChargeDesc: Public EV-charger payment gateway. ČSOB integration, Docker Swarm, Fastify + MongoDB.
home.projectCoraScorecardDesc: Cyber audit tool. NIS2 compliance, PDF export.
home.projectIontAdminDesc: Charger control panel with real-time firmware updates and station diagnostics.
home.projectIontInfoDesc: Full-stack EV charging platform: public info app, payment gateway, admin panel, and Raspberry Pi hardware integration. Built the whole stack: SvelteKit, Fastify, Docker Swarm, MongoDB.
home.projectPangolinDesc: Interactive analytics dashboard with complex data viz.
home.projectNotefulDesc: Note-taking app with tag hierarchies & real-time sync.
home.projectDisenchantmentDesc: A minecraft plugin that enhances the vanilla enchanting system.
home.testimonial0Quote: Jan joined our team as a junior, just starting university. Even back then, it was clear to me that he was a talented programmer. He understands very well that as a programmer, he needs to have a broader perspective beyond just coding. He handled a great deal of work at our company, and it was always evident that he could research the context himself and ask the right questions to fill in any missing product context.
home.testimonial1Quote: We worked with Jan for several months on a complete system for electric vehicle charging stations. Jan is a skilled and thoughtful full-stack developer with an innovative approach to problem-solving and a strong team spirit.
home.testimonial1Role: Full-Stack Developer · IONT Tech · Same team
home.testimonial2Quote: I've worked with Jan on two projects so far. On both occasions, his problem-solving skills and experienced approach shined through. He is familiar with a variety of tools and procedures and is excellent at explaining them thoroughly to less experienced team members. He is also eager to learn new technologies, always dedicated to finding solutions that work best for both the project and the team. Anyone would be lucky to have him!
home.testimonial2Role: Software Engineering · On · Same team, 2 projects
home.testimonial3Quote: I've had the pleasure of working with Jan at HAXAGON, where he worked as a vue.js front-end developer. I'm happy to recommend him for his amazing problem-solving skills and fast learning pace. He quickly picked up on new technology he hadn't used before and very quickly excelled at it.
home.testimonial4Quote: I am thrilled to offer a recommendation for Jan, a valued member of the Customer Portal team I've had the privilege to lead. Jan's standout qualities came to the forefront during his time at Precismo. His ability to tackle complex technical solutions and successfully overcome challenges was truly remarkable. Jan's proficiency in handling technical tasks was truly impressive and left a lasting impact on our projects. His problem-solving skills were particularly evident during his involvement in the 3D Banner project, where he played an instrumental role in resolving challenges and ensuring the project's success. Jan's capability to navigate technical complexities and contribute innovative solutions truly set him apart. One story that particularly exemplified his capabilities was when he undertook a comprehensive analysis for a new Customer Portal module focused on Content Management. In this instance, Jan displayed not only his technical expertise but also his management skills. Were able to break it down into smaller, more manageable work items. This allowed multiple team members to contribute seamlessly, fostering collaboration and ensuring that the project progressed efficiently. Jan's contributions and dedication have been commendable, and I am confident that his skills and drive will continue to make a positive impact on any team he becomes a part of.
home.testimonial4Role: Senior Backend Developer · Precismo · Direct manager
home.testimonial5Quote: I had the pleasure of working with Jan, a mid-level full-stack web programmer who is well-oriented in MySQL databases, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js for backend development. As a valuable member of our Scrum-based web development team, Jan consistently demonstrated his ability to turn project requirements into successful web applications. His expertise in both frontend and backend development makes him a versatile asset to any team. I wholeheartedly recommend Jan for his strong technical skills and commitment to delivering results.
